items.title: Localisation commutes with taking the quotient by a submodule
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that localisation respects quotients: for a submodule N of M there is an isomorphism S^{-1}(M/N) with (S^{-1}M)/(S^{-1}N) (statement lines 1572-1576). The proof does not compare fractions by hand: it puts the quotient into the short exact sequence 0 to N to M to M/N to 0, applies exactness of localisation to get the localised sequence, and reads the quotient off the cokernel term (proof lines 1578-1589). The one substantive input is exactness of localisation, and the author spends the proof exhibiting it as a sequence rather than asserting it. H2.
